title: Go: Strings Package
description: Write a Go program that uses the strings package for common string operations.

codeTemplate.go:
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	text := "Hello, Go World!"
	fmt.Println("Contains 'Go':", strings.Contains(text, "Go"))
	fmt.Println("HasPrefix 'Hello':", strings.HasPrefix(text, "Hello"))
	fmt.Println("HasSuffix 'World!':", strings.HasSuffix(text, "World!"))
	fmt.Println("ToUpper:", strings.ToUpper(text))
	fmt.Println("Count 'o':", strings.Count(text, "o"))
	fmt.Println("Split:", strings.Split(text, ", "))
}

verificationTest: output.includes("Contains 'Go': true") && output.includes("ToUpper: HELLO, GO WORLD!") && output.includes("Count 'o': 3")
hints: Common functions: Contains, HasPrefix, HasSuffix, ToUpper, Count, Split
Use `strings.Split` to split a string into a slice
